snippet.title: DIOXIDE: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist DIOXIDE now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4540840?utm_source=YouTube&utm_campaign=DIOXIDE_SoMe

DIOXIDE is a high-stakes, tactical FPS with soulslike elements set in a dystopian world ravaged by industrial decay. Shatter neo-antique nightmares, scavenge the scraps of a gasping civilization, and forge the last sanctuary. You will die. You will be reprinted. Will you remain human?
